plugins.name: continuous-compaction
plugins.description: Summarizes a conversation when a turn ends above a fill floor, then continues it. /compaction shows and changes the floor for one conversation or all of them.

plugins.name: codex-local-instructions
plugins.description: Codex only: injects the repository's AGENTS.local.md into every session, since Codex loads only AGENTS.md and AGENTS.override.md.

plugins.name: agents
plugins.description: Subagents: code-reviewer attacks one scope for bugs.

plugins.name: bash-permissions
plugins.description: Answers Bash permission prompts: lets known-safe commands through, refuses destructive ones where they would run.

plugins.name: house-style
plugins.description: Flags a standalone HTML page or stylesheet written while the house-style skill is not loaded.

plugins.name: auto-resume
plugins.description: Resumes a turn an API error ended, and posts a desktop notification when it cannot.
